description: Phase 2 constructionist layer: predictions, reflections, improvement recommendations, 'Improve My Portfolio' routing into the EXISTING brokerage, a comparison dashboard, and per-scenario design challenges. Pure logic unit-tested; new Phase-2 data hooks over the FEAT-001 RPCs; Phase-2 UI + a compare route. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps: Create pure logic with colocated tests: src/features/stress-lab/analysis/recommendations.ts (improvement recommendations derived from actual holdings + results — concentration, missing defensive exposure, scenario-specific weakness; never auto-modifies the portfolio) + recommendations.test.ts; src/features/stress-lab/analysis/challenges.ts (per-scenario challenge definitions e.g. Recession lose < 20%, Diversification no sector > 30%, plus a pass/fail evaluator) + challenges.test.ts; src/features/stress-lab/analysis/prediction.ts (prediction-accuracy scoring vs a SimulationResult) + prediction.test.ts.

Create Phase-2 data hooks: src/features/stress-lab/data/use-save-prediction.ts, use-save-reflection.ts, use-challenge-progress.ts calling save_prediction / save_reflection / upsert_challenge_progress via supabase.rpc (no user id), each validating return shape with extended rpc-schemas.ts, mapping not_found/not_owner to friendly copy, and invalidating the relevant query keys on success.

Create Phase-2 UI components under src/features/stress-lab/components/: PredictionForm.tsx (captured BEFORE running; gain/lose + estimate + best/worst picks), ReflectionForm.tsx (reflection questions, saved + reloadable), Recommendations.tsx, ComparisonDashboard.tsx (original vs updated portfolio value and simulated performance for the same scenario, $ and % differences, sector/concentration changes; prior records preserved), ChallengeTracker.tsx (objective + completion status, re-runnable until met). Update components/index.ts.

Create app/stress-lab/compare/[scenarioId].tsx (thin route rendering ComparisonDashboard via useLocalSearchParams). Wire an 'Improve My Portfolio' button in the results flow that calls router.push('/(tabs)/explore') — reuse the existing brokerage, build no second brokerage and modify no holding automatically.

Integrate the prediction step before run and the accuracy/recommendations/reflection sections after run into app/stress-lab/index.tsx and app/stress-lab/results/[simulationId].tsx, keeping routes thin.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test -- src/features/stress-lab` passes including recommendations/challenges/prediction tests.
A student can record a prediction before running and see its accuracy after; reflection responses save and reload.
'Improve My Portfolio' navigates into the existing Explore/brokerage flow and modifies no holding automatically.

After trading and returning, the comparison dashboard shows original vs updated value and simulated performance for the same scenario with $ and % differences and sector/concentration changes, while prior simulation records remain intact.
Per-scenario challenges show objective + completion status, are re-runnable until met, and record completion.
No new runtime dependency is added to package.json.

=== PURE LOGIC (analysis/, colocated tests) ===
- recommendations.ts: deriveRecommendations(result: SimulationResult): Recommendation[] — kinds 'sector-concentration'|'holding-concentration'|'missing-defensive'|'scenario-loss'; each Recommendation = { kind, message, prompt }. Grounded in real holdings/figures; NEVER prescribes a trade or modifies the portfolio; empty/well-balanced portfolio => []. Thresholds: sector >=50%, holding >=40%, scenario loss <=-20%. DEFENSIVE_SECTORS = Consumer Staples/Utilities/Health Care (used only to flag ABSENCE).
- challenges.ts: CHALLENGES (7 per-scenario definitions), challengesForScenario(id), getChallenge(scenarioId, challengeId), evaluateChallenge(challenge, result): ChallengeEvaluation { met, status:'met'|'in_progress', actualBp, summary }. Metrics: 'max-loss-bp' (change_bp >= threshold, negative bound), 'max-sector-share-bp' / 'max-holding-share-bp' (largest <= threshold). Empty portfolio never meets. Deterministic.
- prediction.ts: Prediction { direction:'gain'|'lose', estimatedChangeBp?, pickedBest?, pickedWorst? }; scorePrediction(prediction, result): PredictionAccuracy — field names/semantics MATCH the server save_prediction accuracy payload (directionCorrect, actualDirection, actualChangeBp, estimateErrorBp, bestCorrect, worstCorrect, actualBest, actualWorst). predictionScore(accuracy): 0-100 for display. best/worst ranking ignores null-change holdings, ties to first (matches server 'order by ... nulls last limit 1').

=== DATA HOOKS (src/features/stress-lab/data, barrel index.ts) ===
- rpc-schemas.ts EXTENDED: added predictionAccuracySchema, stressPredictionSchema, stressReflectionSchema, stressChallengeProgressSchema + parsers parseStressPrediction/parseStressReflection/parseStressChallengeProgress + types StressPrediction/StressReflection/StressChallengeProgress/PredictionAccuracyPayload. accuracy fields are snake_case (direction_correct, actual_direction, actual_change_bp|null, estimate_error_bp|null, best_correct, worst_correct, actual_best|null, actual_worst|null) nested under StressPrediction.accuracy (nullable).
- use-save-prediction.ts: usePrediction(simId?, enabled?) read (maybeSingle, unique per sim) + predictionQueryKey(simId)=['stress-lab','prediction',simId]; useSavePrediction() mutation -> supabase.rpc('save_prediction',{p_simulation_id,p_direction,p_estimated_change_bp,p_best,p_worst}) NO user id, validates with parseStressPrediction, invalidates predictionQueryKey on success; mapPredictionError (not_authenticated|not_found|invalid_prediction + fallback); parsePredictionEstimateBp(str) pure helper -> bp clamped to [-10000,10000] (used by the index route to turn a typed % into bp).
- use-save-reflection.ts: ReflectionResponse { question, answer }; useReflection(simId?, enabled?) read (latest by created_at desc, NOT unique) + reflectionQueryKey(simId)=['stress-lab','reflection',simId]; useSaveReflection() -> supabase.rpc('save_reflection',{p_simulation_id,p_responses}) (responses cast to Json at boundary; server requires non-empty array + clamps answers to 280), invalidates reflectionQueryKey; mapReflectionError (not_authenticated|not_found|invalid_reflection). REFLECTION_ANSWER_MAX=280.
- use-challenge-progress.ts: useChallengeProgress(enabled?) lists ALL caller rows + CHALLENGE_PROGRESS_QUERY_KEY=['stress-lab','challenges']; useChallengeProgressUpsert() -> supabase.rpc('upsert_challenge_progress',{p_scenario_id,p_challenge_id,p_status,p_simulation_id}), validates with parseStressChallengeProgress, invalidates the list; mapChallengeError (not_authenticated|not_found|invalid_challenge).
- use-simulation-history.ts EXTENDED: added fetchSimulationsForScenario(scenarioId) + useSimulationsForScenario(scenarioId?, enabled?) (newest-first, backed by the (user_id,scenario_id,created_at desc) index) + scenarioHistoryQueryKey(scenarioId)=['stress-lab','history','scenario',scenarioId]. Used by the compare route to read the latest two runs of one scenario.
- use-run-simulation.ts CHANGED: invalidateAfterRun(client, simulationId, scenarioId?) now also invalidates scenarioHistoryQueryKey(scenarioId) when known; the mutation passes row.scenario_id. (Existing 2-arg test still passes.)

=== COMPONENTS (components/, barrel index.ts) ===
- PredictionForm({ holdings, value: PredictionDraft, onChange, onSubmit, isSaving, saved }) — captured BEFORE run: gain/lose toggle + optional %% estimate + optional best/worst holding chips. PredictionDraft = { direction:'gain'|'lose'|null, estimatePercent:string, pickedBest:string|null, pickedWorst:string|null }.
- PredictionResult({ prediction: StressPrediction }) — renders the server-computed accuracy after the run. SIMULATED badge.
- Recommendations({ result }) — deriveRecommendations rendered; empty => encouragement; ends with the 'prompts not instructions' nudge. SIMULATED badge.
- ChallengeTracker({ scenarioId, result, progress: StressChallengeProgress[] }) — objective + this-run verdict (evaluateChallenge) OR ever-met (persisted status). Re-runnable; the route records progress. SIMULATED badge.
- ReflectionForm({ questions?, answers, onChangeAnswer, onSubmit, isSaving, saved }) — DEFAULT_REFLECTION_QUESTIONS = surprise/weakness/change; private-to-you copy; 280-char cap. Controlled by parent (answers seeded from reloaded reflection).
- ComparisonDashboard({ original: StressSimulation, updated: StressSimulation, scenarioName }) — original (earlier run) vs updated (latest run) of the SAME scenario: side-by-side starting/simulated/change, then $ (starting + simulated ending) and % (simulated performance) differences, then largest-sector / largest-holding / sector-count changes. Reads two PERSISTED immutable snapshots (prior records preserved). SIMULATED badge.

=== ROUTES (app/stress-lab, Expo Router) ===
- compare/[scenarioId].tsx — NEW route '/stress-lab/compare/:scenarioId'. Thin: useLocalSearchParams<{scenarioId}>, useSimulationsForScenario, StateView states; needs >=2 runs else empty state; renders ComparisonDashboard with data[1] (original) vs data[0] (updated). Registered in _layout.tsx Stack as 'compare/[scenarioId]'.
- index.tsx CHANGED — renders PredictionForm between HoldingsBreakdown and the scenario cards; keeps a PredictionDraft in state; on run success saves the prediction (if a direction was chosen) against the server-generated sim id via useSavePrediction, then pushes results. A prediction save failure never blocks seeing results.
- results/[simulationId].tsx CHANGED — after ResultsSummary adds: PredictionResult (when a prediction exists), Recommendations, ChallengeTracker, ReflectionForm (seeded from the reloaded reflection via a memoised seed + local edits map — NO setState-in-effect, to satisfy react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint). Buttons: 'Improve My Portfolio' -> router.push('/(tabs)/explore') (FR-8, modifies NO holding, no second brokerage); 'Compare runs' -> router.push('/stress-lab/compare/<scenario_id>'); 'Try another scenario' -> back.

=== QUERY KEYS ADDED (for later invalidation) ===
['stress-lab','prediction',simId], ['stress-lab','reflection',simId], ['stress-lab','challenges'], ['stress-lab','history','scenario',scenarioId].

=== INTEGRATION NOTES ===
- 'Improve My Portfolio' reuses the EXISTING brokerage (Explore tab) per spec; no portfolio is auto-modified anywhere in Phase 2.
- Prior simulation records are immutable snapshots (FEAT-001); the compare dashboard reads two persisted rows, so trading + re-running never overwrites earlier runs.
- All money stays integer cents via src/lib/money.ts; reflection responses are cast to the db.ts Json type at the supabase.rpc boundary (the {question,answer} object lacks Json's index signature).
- No DB migration or seed change was needed: FEAT-001 already shipped the tables, RPCs, and db.ts Row/Insert/Update + Function signatures for save_prediction/save_reflection/upsert_challenge_progress.
